_how: What's new in The Arcade app (Mac/Windows, Tauri). appbridge.js shows notes[<window.ARCADE_APP.version>] once, after the app updates to that version. Add an entry when you publish an app update: "1.2.0": ["Short sentence.", "Another."]. With no entry for a version it just says which version the app is now on.

1.0.1: The app now opens the GitHub site. Log in with your Arcade account once and all your progress is there.
1.0.2: The app now opens The Arcade's new link, playthearcade.github.io. Log in with your Arcade account once and all your progress is there.
